title: AntPack
description: A collection of mods for use on the AntSMP Minecraft server.
body:
The AntPack is intended to provide a more challenging and multiplayer focused experience to Minecraft. The mod-pack encourages cooperation between players by introducing challening mods such as Cold Sweat, Thirst was Taken, and Serene Seasons that make survival much more difficult alone. In addition, mods like Create, Trackwork, and Eureka! promote the development of industry and infrastructure for transportation and item production. 

This pack was orginally developed for the AntSMP server, however you may freely use it on your own. [Download the server mod-pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/antsmp-server)

# Mod Highlights
- ⚙️ Create
- 💻️ Computer Craft
- 🌡️ Cold Sweat
- 🏞️ Tectonic
- 🧰 Tom's Simple Storage

## System Requirements
- It is recommended to have at least 6GB of memory allocated.
- A discrete GPU is recommended for the usage of shaders.
- For servers, it is recommended to have at least 16GB of memory allocated.

## Known Bugs
- Occasional server crashes. Try allocating more memory or restart server regularly. 


## **Attributions**
- Aquaculture 2 must be downloaded from CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture. Credit to Team Metallurgy and Shadowclaimer
- Framework must be downloaded from CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/framework. Credit to MrCrayfish.
